verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSMs for authentication, signing and encryption. User-configured autonomous background automations are outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Nitrokey ships such a feature. The nitropy CLI and the NetHSM REST API are developer building blocks, not an automation capability, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
